description: Enrichment pipeline for NiFi bulletins - adds severity scoring and error categorization

script.source: if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('Address already in use')) { ctx.bulletinCategory = 'PORT_CONFLICT'; } else if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('OutOfMemoryError') || ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('heap')) { ctx.bulletinCategory = 'MEMORY'; } else if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('timeout') || ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('Timeout')) { ctx.bulletinCategory = 'TIMEOUT'; } else if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('Connection') || ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('connection')) { ctx.bulletinCategory = 'CONNECTION'; } else if (ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('Invalid') || ctx.bulletinMessage.contains('invalid')) { ctx.bulletinCategory = 'INVALID_STATE'; } else { ctx.bulletinCategory = 'OTHER'; }
